swift:
swift-driver version: 1.168.6 Apple Swift version 6.4 (swiftlang-6.4.0.34.1 clang-2100.3.34.1)
Target: arm64-apple-macosx27.0.0
power: Wired USB connection for the whole set; the harness collected no device battery level or charging state.
conditions: Benchmark app kept foregrounded. No overlapping benchmark runs. Power, thermals, and other activity are not controlled.
thermal_observations: Measured from the host process header and trailer. Run 1 and run 3 started fair and run 2 started serious; all three ended serious. A 15-minute idle period before the set did not return the device to nominal. Thermal pressure was not controlled, and the warmest processes were also the slowest.
project_path_placeholders: ${REPOSITORY} is the checkout root; ${GENERATED_HOST} is the disposable generated helper directory.
build_warning: SwiftShims precompiled module file not found warning; build succeeded.
subsequent_runs: Runs 2 and 3 reused the installed binary through `mobilebuildmcp device launch --launch-args run2|run3`.
signing: Automatic signing matched an existing wildcard iOS App Development profile for the recorded team, so no provisioning update was requested. -allowProvisioningUpdates was omitted: the host's stored Apple-account session was rejected when Xcode tried to refresh profiles.
